messages:
sara_ng: customer reported sudden 5-10s tail latencies and about 20% 401s after some requests were auto-routed to a different region. started around 15:12 UTC. workload is pinned to na-west but traffic shows served-region eu-west.

miguel_k: can you paste the gateway request/response headers and any x-fallback-* headers? also which model/route?

liz_support: forwarded the snippets customer sent. key parts below (redacted token):
```
> Request headers:
GET /v1/chat
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-region: na-west-1
Authorization: Bearer sk.cust.XXXX

> Response headers from gateway:
x-served-region: eu-west-1
x-fallback-reason: capacity_exhausted
x-fallback-policy: auto-spillover
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="redwood"
```

liz_support: customer also saw intermittent 503s and long tail latency spikes (~5-10s) when requests were routed to eu-west. they say this impacts real-time chat.

oncall-bot: ALERT: na-west GPU pool utilization 96% at 2026-03-16T15:11:00Z -> auto-spillover engaged to eu-west-1 (alert id: spill-9382).

kevin_ops: that matches. autospill config is set to spill at 95% pool utilization. two likely failure modes: 1) token/scoped auth mismatch when proxy exchanges token across regions -> 401s, 2) cross-region cold model cache causing latency + some 503s. need logs from auth-proxy and routing table.

miguel_k: pulled gateway routing log (trimmed):
```
[15:11:03] route=na-west-1 -> target=na-west-1 served=true util=0.94
[15:11:12] route=na-west-1 -> target=na-west-1 served=true util=0.96
[15:11:15] route=na-west-1 -> target=eu-west-1 served=false fallback=capacity_exhausted code=spillover
[15:11:16] route=na-west-1 -> target=eu-west-1 auth_exchange=attempted status=partial_fail count=3
[15:11:17] route=na-west-1 -> target=eu-west-1 result=401 user=org-12345
[15:11:18] route=na-west-1 -> target=eu-west-1 result=503 model-cold-cache
```

miguel_k: auth_exchange partial_fail means auth-proxy returned 200 for some tokens and 401 for others. looks nondeterministic under load.

billing-bot: NOTE: org-12345 has org-scoped API keys bound to na-west tenant. Cross-region token exchange requires backend exchange to include "audience=eu-west" and short-lived scope. 50% of exchanges failed between 15:11-15:13.

liz_support: customer provided a curl reproducer that gets 401 only when the request is routed to eu-west; when we pinned them back to na-west the 401s stopped.

kevin_ops: immediate mitigation: temporarily disable auto-spillover for na-west -> open infra change to set spillover threshold to 99% and enable progressive spill (drain nodes first). also ask auth team to investigate the token-exchange race under high concurrency.

miguel_k: creating infra ticket INFRA-3456 with logs and timeline. assigning to auth-proxy and runtime teams. steps to reproduce attached to ticket.

liz_support: told customer we'll pin them to na-west until we finish root cause and patch. they asked about credits for impact window 15:11-15:30. forwarding to billing.

billing-bot: ESCALATION: billing review requested for org-12345 impact window 2026-03-16T15:11:00Z to 2026-03-16T15:30:00Z, ticket BILL-789.

kevin_ops: follow-ups: (1) auth team to post blameless RCA draft, (2) infra to add telemetry on auth-exchange failure rate during spill, (3) SDK/docs note about org-scoped keys and cross-region fallback caveats.

sara_ng: thanks — I'll keep customer updated. any ETA on INFRA-3456?

miguel_k: initial triage complete, assigning owners, target hotfix within 8 hours to stop unsafe spillovers and patch auth-exchange path.

liz_support: closing the loop with customer now. will post updates here. :thumbsup:
